findings.evidence: We use MaxOnline and other third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit our Web site. These companies may use information (not including your name, address, email address or telephone number) about your visits to this and other Web sites in order to provide advertisements on this site and other sites about goods and services that may be of interest to you.
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly states that no email address and contact details are shared with third parties, but it also mentions sharing of aggregated information with third-party advertising companies.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence mentions sharing aggregated information with third-party advertising companies, which contradicts the finding of undisclosed sharing of contact data. Additionally, the cited DPDP text pertains to the notice requirement and does not address the sharing of personal data.
